excerpts.quote: Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services
and Server products, comprising SQL Server
Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services
and Server products, comprising SQL Server, Windows Server, Visual Studio, System Center, related Client Access Licenses (“CALs”), and other on-premises offerings.

before_unknown.question: Nuance professional services 与 Nuance Healthcare 的关系是什么？
before_unknown.reason_unanswered: 前者列在 Enterprise and partner services 下，后者列在 Server products and cloud services 下，所选文本没有说明两者的业务关系或共享范围。

after_unknown.question: Nuance professional services 与 Nuance Healthcare 的关系是什么？
after_unknown.reason_unanswered: 原文仅在 Server products and cloud services 下列出“Nuance Healthcare cloud services”（即 Nuance Healthcare 的云服务子集，而非整个 Nuance Healthcare 实体），并另在 Nuance Healthcare 说明中称其同时包含云端与本地部署产品、为医疗行业提供 AI 解决方案；而“Nuance professional services”这一具名服务列在 Enterprise and partner services 下，用于协助客户部署 Nuance 对话式 AI 与环境智能解决方案。原文没有明确说明 Nuance professional services 是否属于 Nuance Healthcare 这一医疗实体或其云服务子集，也未说明两者的业务归属、共享范围或所有权关系，因此两者关系无法从所选文本中确定。
